_comment: Shared vector for the transient insert grant EIP-712 digest, read by all three suites: js/test.mjs,
The builder exists three times, in three languages. Each suite's sign/recover test only proves that a
language agrees with itself; a reordered field or a different domain type in one builder would pass there
and fail only on-chain, where GCACL hashes exactly 'typeString' under the domain below. This fixture pins
the digest every builder must reach, and the two intermediate hashes say which half diverged.
No secret is stored: the signer's private key is the byte 'signerKeyByte' repeated 32 times, and 'user' is
the address that key derives to. 'contract' and 'verifyingContract' are placeholders; the on-chain
verifyingContract is the GCACL proxy. Hashes were produced with eth_account and are confirmed by ethers.
